instruction_ref: CEO 2026-11-25: Sellemy is overly strict beyond recalls; approve the agreed Planning/Product/Research/Writer/QA/Publish simplification and instruct 'それで修正を'
instruction: Within BU-002 only, remove mandatory manufacturer evidence for basic marketplace listing identity, stop treating missing optional excerpts and invalid generated citation formatting as product NG, reduce fifteen all-pair exhaustive duplicate proofs to evidence-based checks of suspicious pairs, retain six distinct products and three editorial axes with two each, and focus Claim QA on decision-material factual assertions. Preserve independent product, editorial, claim and article safety QA and CEO publish approval. Article prose problems return to Writer; confirmed incompatible/duplicate/recalled products return to Product. For short governmental recall source outages use last complete official register for at most seven days with explicit stale indication; complete-data monitoring still retries and reports errors. Add targeted regression tests and retain all historic receipt versions for approved published articles. Persist a distinct source-staleness warning under the existing Sellemy safety-monitor state while using a bounded fresh-enough official snapshot.
implementer: Mac Studio scope-controlled code change; CEO production review required
preserved_rules: No change to other BU, portals, shared platform, Amazon affiliate eligibility, review/rating thresholds or sponsored product exclusions
Six real distinct products across exactly three approved axes with two items each remain mandatory
Proven same-product/color-only duplicates, wrong product, recalled/unsafe products and consequential unsupported claims still block publishing
Product/Editorial/Claim/Safety independent review and CEO approval remain mandatory and independent
Existing approved receipts remain hash-valid and no published article is automatically changed
Unusable or more than seven-day-old government recalls never produce an all-clear
